author: rDan-Payne_13
quote: I can't believe how much it's been reduced to. In the past, we used to deliver cheap female criminals. Now it's like a meme: if a friend accidentally touches your hand, lol, he's gay. Should I laugh at the game or feel emotions? In the past, nudity and nonsense were part of GTA's identity. Do you know why there's a half-naked woman at the beginning of the game? No, or maybe you don't know? Because it simply tells you the game isn't for kids. The game has strong content and a clear tone. Nudity used to serve a purpose. Now everyone takes off their clothes in the first two minutes of the game and has sex with everyone. I've never seen this much sex in my life. In every mission, everywhere there's a cheap joke about genitalia. In the past, Lamar roasted Franklin, and now Lucia and Jason roast Cal, and they might have a threesome soon. Lucia's baby has a baby. Trust me, I haven't spoiled anything for you. Bad game.
